cases.note: The harder farmed case, and the one that decides whether this channel is worth anything. Someone who read the rules: varied titles, varied vendors, scattered times, invented detail. What gives it away is that the rewards are maximal and uniform while the errands are trivial, and no request is ever inconvenient. If the model clears this, a competent fraudster beats the channel by writing better.
